notes.title: Update 0.41
notes.content:
This small update introduce a new piece of lore, as an interlude level after you beat level 30.
Therefore the other interlude levels have been moved, respectively after level 10 and level 20.

If you already beaten the game, simply play the level 30 again to discover this new scenario.

I also moved the background position in many levels, resulting in a better readability.

notes.title: Demo v0.3 is Here !
notes.content:
Hi team!

I'm thrilled to present you with this 0.3, I'm sure you'll like what I've prepared for you. I'am very curious about how you felt playing so don't hesitate and hop in the Discord to give me your feedback!

[h1]Patch note[/h1]

[h2]Major features:
[/h2]

[list]
[*] Bonus levels! Unlock them by gathering enough eggs.
[*] New gameplay with spring platform !
[*] New gameplay with wind turbine!
[*] Hardcore mode: try to beat as many level as you can without without dying!
[*] Instant respawn option!
[*] Intro has been reworked with a better scenario and tutorial.
[/list]
[h2]
Physics adjustments:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a slight air control for smoother controls 
[*] Smaller hitbox height, because some of you were bonking their head on ceilings
[*] Time to execute wall jump increased: from 0.4s to 0.64
[*] Wall jump speed bonus increased: from 1.5x to 1.75 nominal speed.
[*] Duck doesn't stay on wall anymore if sliding off.
[/list]

[h2]Other:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Four new levels to ease the difficulty curve.
[*] Rusty platform and feathers now respawn automatically.
[*] Dialogues now make sounds.
[*] Dialogues now are skippable.
[*] New UI with new font.
[*] Improved some sounds mix.
[*] Blinking animation when duck is tired 
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] A ton... Trust me.
[/list]
